root.label: Mexico authorities remain on alert for heavy rain

events.label: Mexico authorities remain on alert for heavy rain

slots.name: alert status
slots.sentence: Mexican authorities said Thursday that they remain on alert because of forecasts of very heavy rain in the states of Baja California Sur, Sinaloa, and Jalisco, and the possibility of landslides, rising river levels, overflowing rivers and flooding in low-lying areas.
